controller_causality_limitation: Old trace is post-step at 5 ms, while controller updates pre-step at 1 ms. These counts are NOT exact control-update counts and cannot establish command/contact causality.
interpretation: Instantaneous force-threshold gating is not contact existence; zero-force/near-ground samples support a chatter hypothesis. Geometry-gate replay does not establish improved native settling.

gate_description.scope: fixed horizontal ground; full XY footprint of at least one box sole within the ground
gate_description.preload_note: geometry mode may enable feedforward within the envelope before positive load develops
